queries.sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM `fact_order` o JOIN `dim_customer` c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN `fact_order_item` oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN `dim_product` p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'COMPLETE' AND c.region = 'NA' AND p.category = 'featured' GROUP BY o.order_id, c.region ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20
